newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chu Kong Shipping poised for strong debut.
newsitem.headline: Chu Kong Shipping poised for strong debut.

text.p: Chu Kong Shipping Development Co Ltd is expected to have a successful debut on Friday when its shares begin trading in Hong Kong because of strong subscriptions and the current popularity of China-backed companies, analysts said.
Chu Kong Shipping was also seen benefiting from bright business prospects for the cargo business in the Pearl River delta of south China, analysts added.
"A strong debut is expected. The high subscription level indicated that there was still very strong demand for red-chip stocks," said Hugo So, analyst at Yamaichi International.
The demand for Chu Kong Shipping followed the pattern of Hong Kong investors snapping up shares of new companies backed by Chinese authorities.
Chu Kong Shipping said its initial public offering last week of 187.5 million new shares at HK$1.20 each was oversubscribed by about 480 times.
The company, which is under the supervision of the Guangdong provincial government, is mainly engaged in river transportation between Hong Kong and ports in the Pearl River delta.
"Investors are buying for (the company's) Chinese government connection which will enhance future earnings growth," So said.
Analysts said the possible future injection of assets and local investors' familiarity with the company's parent had also made the stock popular.

"Local investors are familiar with the company... hope of future asset injection and the bright business outlook on cargo handling services have made it particularly attractive," said Pamela Lam, analyst at Pacific Challenge Securities.
The company's parent, Chu Kong Shipping Enterprises Holdings Co Ltd (CKSE), has been operating as a Hong Kong-based company for 35 years.
Analysts said they expected the stock to have limited upside potential in the short run due to its high grey market price of about HK$3.00 per share.
"I think the upside is limited as the stock will be fairly valued at above its grey market price which is already doubled its issue price," Lam said.
Yamaichi's So said the stock is worth holding for one to two years because the company was well positioned to take advantage of the fast economic growth in the Pearl River delta.
Chu Kong Shipping provides ship and cargo owners with a wide range of services including shipping agency, river trade cargo direct shipment and transhipment, wharf cargo handling and storage.
CKSE is wholly-owned by Guangdong Province Navigation Holdings Co Ltd, one of the key enterprises under the direct supervision of the Guangdong Provincial Government.
